description: Reported Crack Me from the post, and had the comedy's rolls ready for the morning.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Counted four weeks from the ninth of September, and left the gown where it was.
name: John Heminges

description: Offered the cover, and stayed when it was refused.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Kept the gown, named twelve pence as a later price, and went on.
name: William Shakespeare
